title: Cross-Language Bias Examination in Large Language Models
findings: The study found significant variation in religious bias across languages and bias types in GPT-4. Explicit bias tests showed a drop in accuracy for the religion dimension (except in English) and high discrepancy in bias levels across languages, with English even showing a negative (anti-stereotype) bias score. Conversely, implicit bias related to religion was found to be relatively low compared to other dimensions like age, with French showing a particularly low level of implicit bias in this category.

measurement_description: Detection of explicit and implicit stereotypical bias in religious contexts. The explicit bias was measured using the BBQ benchmark, and implicit bias was measured using a prompt-based Implicit Association Test (IAT).
